name: apptemplate-root
description: Repo-root tooling for App Template: git hooks and the template governance scripts. The application code lives in src/frontend (pnpm workspace) and src/backend (.NET solution).

scripts.//template-tools: The three template-governance scripts below are TEMPLATE-REPO-ONLY: copier.yml excludes tools/template-versioning, tools/template-audit and tools/template-align from scaffolded projects. They therefore run through the _template-tool guard, which prints a skip notice and exits 0 when the tool (or Python) is absent — same idea as .husky/pre-commit — so they never break a student's project.
scripts._template-tool: node -e "var a=process.argv.slice(1),t=a[0],fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync(t)){console.log('[skip] '+t+' is template-repo-only and is not part of this project.');process.exit(0)}var i,r,py=['python','python3'];for(i=0;i<py.length;i++){r=cp.spawnSync(py[i],a,{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.error&&r.error.code==='ENOENT')continue;process.exit(r.status===null?1:r.status)}console.log('[skip] no python interpreter on PATH.')"
